case_name: Smt. Deepika D vs Sri. Yeshwanth Kumar B M

parties.respondent_defendant: Sri. Yeshwanth Kumar B M, husband

facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized on 25.11.2020 and they have no issues. Petitioner/wife is not working and resides with her parents at Mysuru. Respondent/husband initiated proceedings in M.C.No.3448/2021 seeking dissolution of marriage.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a case to establish sufficient reasons for the same.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that it would be difficult for the petitioner/wife to travel from Mysuru to Bengaluru, since she has no income of her own.

legal_principles.principle: A party's inability to travel due to financial constraints can be a sufficient reason for transferring a case.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that it would be difficult for the petitioner/wife to travel from Mysuru to Bengaluru, since she has no income of her own.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings in M.C.No.3448/2021 pending on the file of the Principal Judge Family Court at Bengaluru is directed to be transferred to the Family Court at Mysuru for further consideration.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition under Section 24 CPC
preparing a divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
responding to a transfer petition in a family court
